## Why This Is Asked
Assesses ability to assemble a basic yet compliant Azure OpenAI workflow with gating, logging, and versioned prompts.

- Azure OpenAI Service behind API Management
- Azure Functions orchestration
- versioned prompts in Azure Blob
- PII redaction and content-filter guardrails

## Code Example
```javascript
function redactPII(text) {
  return text
    .replace(/\b[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}\b/gi, "[REDACTED_EMAIL]")
    .replace(/\b\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4}\b/g, "[REDACTED_PHONE]");
}
```

```javascript
function postFilter(text) {
  const blocked = /\b(badword1|badword2|disallowedTopic)\b/i;
  return blocked.test(text) ? "[REDACTED_CONTENT]" : text;
}
```

## Why This Is Asked

This question probes model governance, drift detection, automated retraining, and data lineage in a realistic Azure OpenAI deployment for multi-tenant SaaS.

## Key Concepts

- Drift detection metrics: KL divergence, perplexity, and policy compliance scoring
- CI/CD for ML: dataset versioning, Azure ML pipelines, gated promotion
- Data lineage with Purview and Cognitive Search KB grounding
- RBAC per-tenant with Azure AD; auditable Data Lake logs

## Code Example

```python
aimport numpy as np

def kl_div(p, q):
    p = p / p.sum()
    q = q / q.sum()
    return float(np.sum(p * np.log(p / q)))

def drift_exceeds(current, baseline, thresh=0.1):
    return kl_div(current, baseline) > thresh
```
